description: Store.update_pointer/5 (710-713) stores a separate {vesting_time, queue_id} key at each distinct enqueue/lease/renewal time, rather than a single maintained pointer per queue. scan_visible_queues/3 (605-621) limits raw rows before deduplicating, always from the beginning. cleanup_past_pointers/4 scans only the first 100 global rows, and runs only when the new minimum is in the future; GC will not remove pointers while a queue remains non-empty. Reproduced: hot queue with ready timestamps 1..20, small queue at 30, now 10000; scan(limit: 10) returns only hot before AND after leasing its first ten jobs, while scan(limit: 100) sees both. Consumer.init/1 (consumer.ex:64,98) passes the job batch_size to Scanner, overriding its 20000 default with 10 in normal startup; selection_frac 0.02 then chooses only one queue per scan. Fix pointer lifecycle and scan progression, separate configuration, and provide a starvation-prevention mechanism comparable to QuiCK's ordered scanner. Test sustained skew and stale/duplicate pointers with actual range limits.
title: Restore fair pointer discovery and separate scanner and dequeue batch sizes
